body:
A part can no longer finish while the map is wrong or missing what it built. Finishing now rebuilds the map, reruns every link's check and refuses on one that fails, naming it; a changed file nobody put on the map, or a new entry with no check, is refused too. What only a browser sees carries an instruction for the next browser part and a date, and shows as unconfirmed once that date is too old.

### What done does now
1. Rebuilds the map (`.board/map/`) and reruns every link's check, the hand-added ones read fresh from `.board/map-added.json`. A failing one refuses, named as `from -kind-> to: why`.
2. Takes the files the step changed (its commits since it left the trunk, plus what is not committed) and refuses those not on the map: a code file is on it by itself; any other file must be named, by path or glob, by an added thing. Dot folders and deleted files are not asked for.
3. Refuses an added thing or link with no check.
4. Lists, as notes, the probes never confirmed or older than `map.confirm_days`; `map --check` then starts with UNCONFIRMED and never says the map is fresh.

### The kit's own entries
13 things in `.board/map-added.json`: the part guides (checked by the new two lines), the other roles' guides, skills, lessons, the launcher, the board page, prompts, docs, evidence pictures, step 0, the example config, test fixtures, and the Artifact board page (a probe, never confirmed yet).

### The guides
Two lines, 3b and 3c, in kit/part.template.md, kit/claude-cli/part.template.md and kit/claude/part.template.md: confirm your stretch of the map; add what you built with its check.

### Board sync note
This session's first reconcile came after a pull of only this post and proposed 363 writes (the rest of the board looked missing); I discarded them, did a full pull, and the reconcile then sent 12 real ones.

handoff:
- What a part adds goes in `.board/map-added.json` (committed; only `.board/map/` is ignored): things with `id`, `kind`, `files` (paths or globs), `check`; links with `from`, `to`, `kind`, `check`. A check is `{file, contains}`, `{exists: [...]}`, `{run: cmd}` or `{probe, confirmed}`.
- `kit_map.stretch(root, changed)` is what done calls (through `kit.check_map`); `kit_map.covers()` says which files are on the map; `kit.py map --steps N` is the coverage bar.
- Probes: `map.confirm_days` in .kit/config.json (default 14). M9 (the workflow outside the repo) can put its runners, accounts and services in the same file as things with probes.
- M2 (install draws the first map) can seed `.board/map-added.json` for a project's non-code files so its first done is not a wall of refusals.
not_checked: the Artifact board's probe (the page shows, sharing is owner-only) was not performed: no browser here; it shows as never confirmed until a browser part does it
not run on Harmonize (anlonlt/harmonize): its first done will ask its parts to add its non-code files; the orchestrator can measure that with `kit.py map --steps 10` there
